search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows "Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfProc_Process" "_Total" "IOReadBytesPersec" 
| parse regex "winbox = (?<dest_host>\S+)" nodrop 
| if (isNull(dest_host) or dest_host="",_sourceHost,dest_host) as host
| kv regex "= (?:\"|)(.*?)(?:\"|);" keys "IOReadBytesPersec","Name" as ioReadBytes,procName | where procName = "_Total"
| timeslice 1m 
| avg(ioReadBytes) as AvgIOReadBytes by host, _timeslice | sort - _timeslice | int(AvgIOReadBytes/(1025*1024)) as AvgIOReadMBytes | fields - AvgIOReadBytes
| transpose row _timeslice column host
